# RF uncertainty and open-set flags (DroneRF)

**Inherits the RF caveat:** DroneRF scores look like recording-session artefacts (see `rf_detection.md`), so low error rates here do not show real-world reliability. Generated by `scripts/eval_rf_uncertainty.py`.

Forest on 128 level-free sub-band features, threshold at 1% FPR on validation; review band = the 10% of validation windows nearest the threshold; familiarity cut at the 95% quantile of validation distances.

## Tier 1 (held-out time)

- test windows: 320, error rate 0.003
- flagged low confidence: 13.4%, holding 100% of the errors
- states: drone 245, low confidence 43, no drone 32
- error rate on the most certain windows (margin): 100% coverage 0.003, 90% coverage 0.000, 80% coverage 0.000, 70% coverage 0.000, 50% coverage 0.000

## Open set: is a drone never trained on flagged as an unknown signature?

Distance to the known drones' features; known = held-out time of the other two drones.

| held-out drone | AUROC unknown vs known | unknown flagged | known flagged |
|---|---|---|---|
| bebop | 0.968 | 91.4% (840) | 2.7% (150) |
| ar | 0.448 | 0.0% (810) | 3.3% (150) |
| phantom | 0.968 | 92.9% (210) | 2.5% (240) |

Detector saved to `data/models/rf_detector.joblib`.
